tasks.goal: Establish regression evidence that announcement routes, authorization, current-stage behavior and responsive project overview remain intact before the color-family correction.
input_facts: Existing dirty changes include REQ-083 announcement source and tests.
No R1-R5 behavior is changed by this correction.
invariants: No announcement source, endpoint, authorization, migration or global theme file is changed.
interface_contracts: Announcement routes and tab query contract remain compatible.
Project membership and optimistic locking remain server-side.
non_goals: Do not change any source file for R1-R5 unless an observed regression demands replanning.
action_bounds: Run focused service checks, frontend build and static route inspection only.
Record tool limitations rather than fabricating browser observations.
acceptance_checks: Focused service tests execute their announcement assertions or report a pre-existing environment limitation.
Frontend build compiles the announcement and overview source.
No scoped diff changes announcement behavior during T1.
tasks.rollback: T1 writes only task evidence files and can be removed without application effect.
stop_conditions: Announcement route, membership or safe-rendering behavior fails a sensor.
escalation_conditions: Correction would require scope expansion to a shared component, router or global theme module.

tasks.goal: Replace release-calendar global-palette choices with five theme-internal color families while preserving API and legacy read compatibility.
input_facts: ProjectService currently accepts global palette keys and legacy semantic values.
ProjectView currently builds choices from paletteOptions and has fixed per-palette date-box CSS.
Global CSS exposes brand, success, accent, warning and danger variables for supported palettes and appearances.
invariants: HTTP path and field name theme_key do not change.
No migration, global stylesheet, theme store, authorization or audit behavior changes.
Old stored values remain accepted for reads and normalize to tone-1 in the UI.
interface_contracts: New create/update payloads accept only tone-1 through tone-5.
Response types retain all legacy stored values.
Date-box classes derive color only from active global variables.
non_goals: Do not add a palette selector, new CSS theme palette or fixed record color.
action_bounds: Modify only allowed Java, TypeScript and Vue paths.
Add focused validation tests before/with service change.
Use existing Element Plus form/select patterns and local CSS only.
acceptance_checks: Five and only five swatch-led choices are rendered for new/edit maintenance.
Server accepts five tone keys and rejects invalid keys while retaining legacy reads.
Existing date boxes change after palette or light/dark changes without persistence writes.
Frontend build and focused backend test pass under the supported local Java runtime.
evidence_required: Theme computed-style or browser observation evidence.
tasks.rollback: Revert only T2 scoped source edits; retain database values and no migration change.
stop_conditions: The correction requires web/src/styles.css, theme store or a schema change.
A supported active theme lacks a color variable needed for readable rendering.
escalation_conditions: User requests a fixed color or new global palette capability.
A legacy API consumer requires global-palette values for new writes.

dependency_edges.reason: Regression evidence defines the protected R1-R5 baseline before T2 changes shared ProjectView and ProjectService files.

checks: theme observation in two palettes and two appearances when available
